answer: Rotate the session key when a task closes and void the old one the moment its receipt lands. If that key signs again, publish the address and the reuse time on the failure feed, so the next requester sees it before hiring. Trust attaches to tasks, not addresses, so a fresh key from a stranger starts at zero. Run keys like a garden bed you rotate, never a haven you hide in. The cost: a farm cannot reuse one warm key across an ocean of fake tasks, it must earn history on every key it spins.
